item_2_new_play_magnitude_block_gap_owne.read: OWNERSHIP DECISION at the prior close, strict order: (1) ANCHOR_STRUCTURAL - is a structural driver live? (squeeze building; squeeze sponsor DEAD with premium still in the front; armed parabolic crest) -> the gap belongs to the structural resolution: sign = the resolution direction, magnitude DERIVED per item 11: dead-sponsor form gap = -E (the post-expiry echo run, band 0.75-1.25E); live-squeeze pull form +1500..+2500 (n=1, 0125); armed-crest form = the flip's counter-delivery class -1800..-2900 (1207). (2) WEEKEND_CYCLE_WEATHER - no structural driver: the weekend model cycle's fresh-vs-priced arms (the incumbent weekend_gap_delivery bands: fresh +1500..+2500, priced +200..+400). (3) CHAIN_DRIFT - no structural driver, no fresh weather: prior close AT its chain-side extreme -> the weekend delivers a chain-session continuation, band -600..-1600 at chain sign (n=2 THIN: 1130 -590 delivered as the Sunday session, 0208 -1550 as the gap; flagged).
item_2_new_play_magnitude_block_gap_owne.mechanism: A squeeze/parabolic premium is carried by a FLOW (delivery covering, trapped shorts), not by a stock of information. When the flow's sponsor dies (prompt expiry, covering complete), the premium decays at the first long liquidity gap - the weekend is the longest gap on the calendar, so the repricing concentrates there. Weather gaps, by contrast, are information-stock repricings and scale with the weekend cycle's delta. That is why the same feed that correctly read 'no weather change' on 0201 coexisted with the walk's largest gap.

A disagreeing print trades WITH its sign when the chain is SPENT: price at/past its retrace target, the chain's driver expired, basing rhythm in force (0129: bleed-end at the walk's lows; 0205/0212: basing at the pre-squeeze shelf after a completed unwind). With-print days at a spent chain are IN-BAND counter days (+1480 max, then +540, +120 - never band-breaking) and are FLIP-CHECKLIST WATCH INPUTS (the 0129->0130 sequence ended the last down-regime), never flips by themselves.

item_8_scoring_convention_block_opening_.action: ADD to doctrine_tier3.scoring_split - GAP OWNERSHIP SCORING (Greg's order, part c)
item_8_scoring_convention_block_opening_.rule: Gap and net remain separately scored events; what changes is that OWNERSHIP is explicit and the reporting cannot hide one behind the other. (1) DECLARE: every forecast of a block-opening or Sunday reopen gap must carry gap_owner in {anchor_structural, weekend_cycle_weather, chain_drift} declared AT THE ANCHOR/prior close, plus the band class used. (2) SCORE: the scorecard's day row carries gap_dir_ok AND gap_class_ok (realized gap inside the declared band, tail declared = miss with named tail) at EQUAL RANK with net_dir_ok; reopen days additionally carry day_move_dir_ok (sign of gap+net) - the headline hit/miss for a reopen day is the day_move composite, so 0201 reads MISS (+150g vs -7590a day move) with the net sub-score a hit, never the reverse. (3) ATTRIBUTE: when the realized gap's driver class differs from the declared owner, the OWNERSHIP call is scored as the miss (a new ownership_ok flag) - that is the exact error 0201 exposes (blind declared weather-priced; the driver was structural). (4) DRIFT attribution names gap residual separately from net residual per day, as g12_score already does numerically - the change is the headline convention.
item_8_scoring_convention_block_opening_.g13_0215_procedure: At the 0213 anchor (close 3.084 on instrument 996/April): FIRST declare the 0215 gap owner. Structural check: March (NGH26) expiry Feb 25 falls INSIDE G13 and squeeze_watch's day-count is <=7 from 0213 - read the March-April spread's level and 3d change at the anchor (0212 vintage: +0.137): positive-AND-widening -> anchor_structural owner, squeeze doctrine (bands void on the squeeze leg; the walk instrument is April, once-removed - the G12 handoff note stands); flat/narrowing (the G12-observed state: collapsed from +0.336 to ~+0.09-0.16 post-unwind) -> no structural owner. THEN the weekend cycle: fresh/accelerating shot at D+2..D+6 -> weather owner with the fresh band at the shot's sign; nothing fresh -> chain_drift owner: 0213 closed -160 mid-range (NOT at a chain extreme), so the drift band is the priced stub +-200..400 at chain sign, NOT the -600..-1600 continuation class (that class requires a prior close AT its extreme). Score 0215 per (2)-(3): gap_dir, gap_class, ownership, then the Sunday session net as its own event, then day_move composite as the headline.

item_11_structural_sizing_rule_final.title: THE FINAL SIZING RULE (iteration 2) - structural-unwind magnitude DERIVED from anchor-measurable quantities, never a fitted constant
item_11_structural_sizing_rule_final.rule_statement: CONDITION: the prompt month's expiry has passed within <=~3 sessions AND its premium is STRANDED in the surviving front (a parabolic squeeze leg ran into that expiry; front-next spread multiples of its norm; cash-basis blow-off) - the anchor_structural gap-owner condition of item 2. BEHAVIOR, all quantities measurable at the decision-time close: (1) define the PREMIUM P = anchor close minus the PRE-SQUEEZE SHELF (the close of the last session before the squeeze-pull leg began - the squeeze leg's giveback_origin_shelf; G12: 4.416 - 3.159 = $12,570); (2) define the ECHO RUN E = cum net of the sessions strictly AFTER the prompt expiry (calendar-defined, zero discretion; G12: 0129 +1480 + 0130 +5020 = +$6,500); (3) DEAD-SPONSOR WEEKEND GAP = -E, band -0.75E..-1.25E (G12: -4,875..-8,125; refined -6,500; actual -7,080 = 1.09E, IN BAND); (4) NEXT SESSION = unwind-to-shelf: net = -(prior actual close - shelf) less a basing stub of a few hundred, band ~+-20% (G12: remaining -4,980; refined -4,500 band -4,000..-5,000; actual -4,260 to 3.231, the shelf 3.159 held to a 0.072 stub); (5) the SHELF HOLDS in the squeeze form (the premium, not the fundamental level, was the error) - versus the weather-parabola form where the origin BREAKS (G9 1211 through 4.367); this is the named discriminator between the two post-parabolic classes.
item_11_structural_sizing_rule_final.mechanism: Post-expiry appreciation in the front has no delivery anchor and no sponsor - it is covering echo. No holder carries unowned squeeze premium across the longest liquidity gap on the calendar, so the echo run evaporates entirely at the weekend reopen (gap = -E), and the remainder of the stranded premium unwinds to the level where the squeeze-pull began (the shelf) in the following session(s), where it stops - because below the shelf price is no longer squeeze-priced.
item_11_structural_sizing_rule_final.n_and_honesty: n=1 dead-sponsor instance (0201-0202) for the magnitude derivation - declared. What makes it a rule and not a fit: (a) every input (expiry date, E, P, shelf) is a mechanical anchor-state quantity, no free constant (the retrace fraction is 1.0 = 'entirely', not tuned); (b) the CONDITION is n=3-backed at the ownership level (structural gaps 1207/0125/0201 spanning G9/G11/G12); (c) prompt expiries occur EVERY month of the walk and the rule fires exactly once - no other month had stranded premium (no squeeze leg, normal spreads, no cash blow-off) - its eleven non-firings ARE the back-check; (d) the armed-crest structural gap (1207) is a DIFFERENT class (flip counter delivery, existing crash/counter band) and is NOT sized by this rule - stated below.

b_monday_toolbag.phase_structure: Four named phases: (1) SUNDAY REOPEN GAP - electronic, prices the weekend per the gap owner; (2) overnight/Asia-Europe drift - thin; (3) THE CATCH-UP WINDOW ~06-10 ET (Greg: 7-10) - human desks reprice/judge the weekend move; (4) post-10 ET - the day's chain behavior proper owns the close.
b_monday_toolbag.ownership: The OPEN belongs to the weekend toolbag (gap owner). The CATCH-UP WINDOW belongs to R3's reaction verdict - this is the COMPOSITION Greg asked for: R3's 'Monday is the reaction' is not spread over the day, it is CONCENTRATED 06-10 ET, where the desk either FADES/repositions the electronic overnight or RATIFIES it into delivery. The CLOSE belongs to the chain state (ordinary day-net rules).

addendum_holiday_doctrine.provenance: Greg, final input pre-merge (faithful): 'holidays can only be scored against that holiday historically. unfortunately he won't have that but it will probably look closer to a Sun than Mon.'
addendum_holiday_doctrine.a_holiday_day_class: HOLIDAY sessions are their OWN day-class, comparable only to the SAME holiday in prior years - never to generic Mondays/weekdays.
addendum_holiday_doctrine.b_named_structural_gap: The walk has NO prior-year holiday history (one winter of data). This is a NAMED structural gap - never proxy it silently with weekday evidence.
addendum_holiday_doctrine.c_default_prior: Absent same-holiday history, the DEFAULT PRIOR for a holiday session is the SUNDAY-LIKE read: thin tape, state-reads-only, drift bands, rhythm tools VOID - the Sunday-session read set of (a), NOT the Monday toolbag. A holiday Monday reads closer to a Sunday than a Monday.

The thin-amplifier exception (1111, 1128) remains conditional on a LIVE delivery catalyst and is itself holiday-class evidence, n=2.

addendum_epistemic_stance.provenance: Greg, final input pre-merge (faithful): 'the same things may explain everything every day regardless of day, but I don't think it will.'
addendum_epistemic_stance.stance: The day-class layer is a FALSIFIABLE HYPOTHESIS, not dogma. If forward blocks show the same rules explaining all day-classes, the scoping COLLAPSES BACK to the uniform core. The per-play validity table is the instrument that will show it either way: score every play's fires per day-class going forward; systematic in-band performance of 'void'-tagged reads is the falsification signal. G13 is the first forward test.
